results.title: Picking a block opens the panel with its id, label and kind
Changing the label rewrites the code and the drawing
Changing the kind rewrites the keyword in the code
A change the strict gate refuses leaves the code and says why
Keyboard: Escape returns to the board; the panel is a labelled region
PlantUML and Mermaid files download with the right extension and content
A notation without a mapping is refused with a clear message
Russian page speaks Russian; both themes render the panel
The panel fits a phone width
Choosing a colour writes color=#rrggbb, paints the block with readable text
The colour goes to the Mermaid file; Clear colour removes it from the code
A notation without colours says so in the panel
Russian page, dark theme: the colour field works
No errors in the browser console
